scripts.check: pnpm lint && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test
scripts.contracts:build: turbo run build --filter=@tripflix/core-api... && pnpm --filter @tripflix/contracts export-schemas && pnpm --filter @tripflix/core-api export-openapi
scripts.stack:up: docker compose -f deploy/compose.yaml --profile be --profile fe --profile gateway up -d --build
scripts.stack:full: docker compose -f deploy/compose.yaml --profile be --profile ai --profile fe --profile gateway up -d --build
scripts.stack:ai:down: docker compose -f deploy/compose.yaml --profile ai stop ai-service ai-summary-worker
scripts.stack:be: docker compose -f deploy/compose.yaml --profile be --profile gateway up -d --build
scripts.stack:watch: docker compose -f deploy/compose.yaml --profile be --profile fe --profile gateway watch
scripts.stack:watch:full: docker compose -f deploy/compose.yaml --profile be --profile ai --profile fe --profile gateway watch
scripts.stack:down: docker compose -f deploy/compose.yaml --profile be --profile ai --profile fe --profile gateway --profile tools down
scripts.stack:reset: docker compose -f deploy/compose.yaml --profile be --profile ai --profile fe --profile gateway --profile tools down -v
